title: RS3 Equilibrium residual combat gaps after residual polish pass
testsNote: Combat suite: Relentless EV + prior Wave F / Crackling / Planted Feet / equipment partial bonuses as of residual polish 2026-07-26
scope: Honest residual gaps after residual combat polish. Closed items are summary-only; open items are actionable gaps with severity. Re-audited against source tree (not Wave F snapshot).

gaps.description: Partial closure of former P0 empty-bonuses gap. ~19/87 equipment records now carry wiki-sourced accuracy/armour/prayer/damage bags; materials, codices, set aggregates, and many armour pieces remain {}. Flat combat Damage is not folded into base ability damage; weapon Accuracy ratings are catalog/display only (hit chance uses tier curve via playerAccuracy). No full aggregator path from doll → AD for ranking BiS beyond tier.
gaps.recommendation: Continue sourcing empty wearable bags (wiki equipment pages, verifiedAt). Keep empty objects — do not invent. Optionally surface equippedBonuses in Analysis for transparency; only fold non-weapon damage into AD if a single wiki formula is verified. Prioritise remaining BiS ST weapons/armour.

gaps.description: Most high-value perks are sim- or loadout-wired: Equilibrium, Eruptive, Biting, Ultimatums, Lunging, Energising, Invigorating, Impatient, Crackling EV, Aftershock EV, Planted Feet duration, Relentless EV (sim path only). Residual: (1) Relentless rank not on LoadoutPerks / PerksPanel / loadoutStats — only SimulateInput.adrenaline.relentlessRefundChance; (2) Caroming remains multi-target formula helpers only (ST sim has no secondary targets); (3) Planted Feet DoT strip not modelled; (4) Precise is band-side helper only by design.
gaps.recommendation: Optional: add relentless rank (0–5) + level20 toggle to loadout like Impatient and feed relentlessRefundChance from relentlessProcChance. Leave Caroming until multi-target scope exists. Do not invent CD-aware Relentless without a cast clock for the 30s ICD.

gaps.description: Partial closure only. Many engine channels/DoTs carry wiki tickOffset schedules (Assault, Flurry, Asphyxiate, Rapid Fire, bleeds, etc.) and simulate.ts lands expected damage on readyTick + tickOffset. Residual: (1) multi-hits without a wiki inter-hit schedule intentionally have no offsets (Wild Magic, Hurricane, several twin hits) so all damage stacks on cast tick; (2) record-adapter specs (specFromRecord) never emit tickOffset — flat simultaneous hits; (3) style buff multipliers for a cast are still evaluated at readyTick (cast tick), not per landTick, so multi-hit channels under a buff window that expires mid-channel are not time-sliced. Module comment on simulate() was refreshed to match tickOffset behaviour.
gaps.recommendation: Audit any remaining channelled AbilitySpecs that still omit offsets where the wiki states an interval. For buff windows, evaluate damage mult per landTick when tickOffset is present. Do not invent offsets where wiki is silent.

gaps.description: Greater Barge base hit (75–95%) is modelled; appliesBuff marker exists. Idle damage scale (+5 min / +7 max AD% per idle tick, cap 10 ticks / 6s) and Endless Assault (after 4.8s idle, next channelled melee within 6s treated as DoT) are UNVERIFIED in sim. Helpers exist in styles/melee/effects.ts (greaterBargeIdleBand) but are not auto-wired. Wiki tooltip vs analysis conflict on whether idle is pure last-attack time or off-target movement (Surge/Escape/Bladed Dive) — sim correctly refuses to invent an idle clock. Comment in simulate.ts: 'greater_barge: idle scale + Endless Assault need off-target idle (UNVERIFIED in sim).'
gaps.recommendation: Resolve idle definition from a single authoritative source (live test or unambiguous wiki analysis). Only then wire an off-target idle clock into the sim and apply greaterBargeIdleBand + Endless Assault channel transform. Until verified, leave base hit only.

gaps.description: Pulverise hit band (300–340%), 60% adren cost, 60s CD, ultimate category are engine-modelled and on the 2H ST bar. Outgoing DPS sim does not model Pulverised (−25% damage dealt by target for 30s) or on-kill +50% adren — defensive / kill-gated effects against a generic immortal target. Documented in MELEE_EFFECTS notes and simulate.ts skip comment.
gaps.recommendation: Optional: when target model gains kill/HP or defensive DPS, apply PULVERISE_DEBUFF_DAMAGE_REDUCTION to target outgoing and grant kill adren. Not required for pure player-DPS ST ranking.

gaps.description: Style/bar mismatch risk for shared-style and multi-style slots. Current code: resolveBarSlot passes bar.style into specFromRecord for shared records (Sacrifice → necro/ranged/etc.). Tests assert necro Sacrifice gets style necromancy and modelledBy record. Concurrent agent work may still leave Adaptive Strike setup / map drift. Flag residual until a full ST bar resolve matrix is re-run after concurrent edits.
gaps.recommendation: After concurrent agents land, re-run resolveBar matrix for all PvME ST bars and assert every non-null abilityId resolves engine|record with style matching bar (or documented shared override). Fix any remaining Adaptive Strike setup / map drift.

gaps.description: Multi-target PvME and wiki Revolution bars are intentionally omitted from data/combat/revolution-bars.json. App scope is single-target only (product decision 2026-07-26). Multi-target ability mechanics (Soul Strike splash, Blood Siphon channel to non-primaries, Death Skulls bounce, etc.) are also thin or solo-only in engine. Caroming secondary-target math stays formula-only for the same reason.
gaps.recommendation: Keep omitted until ST path is solid. If product expands, import multi bars only after conjure policy and multi-hit primary/splash models exist; do not half-ship multi bars with silent zero damage.

gaps.description: Uncommitted mixed git tree risk: multiple agents and data/engine waves on the same day leave combat, scraped-data, and possibly unrelated files dirty together. Prior combat-sync validation already saw local/remote divergence and concurrent uncommitted data work. Clash-rename / partial commits can silently drop or mix combat fixes with unrelated progression scrapes.
gaps.recommendation: Before any combat commit: git status scoped to src/combat, data/combat, scraped-data/combat-*, docs/combat-*; stage only combat-owned paths; run vitest combat suite. Do not bundle regional-skilling or asset dumps with combat. Reconcile with origin/main before push. This report file is documentation only — do not commit it as a stand-in for code freezes.
